description.value: Version history provides a complete log of changes in your project. In this Git-style workflow, you can revert to previous versions, track modifications, and sync work in progress with new changes on your live branch.

The formula editor is where you construct business logic for your application in Nordcraft. It provides a powerful way to transform data,perform calculations,and implement conditional logic throughout your application.

description.value: Nordcraft provides a managed hosting platform with automatic scaling, performance monitoring, and a global CDN, ensuring your applications are fast, wherever your users are.

Branches in Nordcraft allow you to develop new features or fix issues without affecting the live version of your project. They provide a safe environment to make and test changes before making them available to users.
Live branch previews let you see changes in real time before pushing them live. This ensures that new features or updates can be validated without impacting production.
Pages are the foundation of applications in Nordcraft,representing distinct screens with unique URLs that users navigate to.
Streaming data enables real-time updates in your application. With Nordcraft, you can receive live data from APIs or services, ensuring your interface stays up-to-date without manual refreshes.
Using components,you can create reusable parts of your application and break large applications down into smaller,more manageable pieces.
Nordcraft's runtime is just 28kb when compressed. This keeps your websites fast and efficient and ensures smooth performance even for complex interfaces.

Web Components are standardized HTML elements that can be reused across projects. Nordcraft lets you export any component as a standalone web component, providing full flexibility and compatibility with all of your development tools.
A workflow in Nordcraft is a series of actions that are executed on certain events. It can contain complex logic and trigger behaviors.
Deployment in Nordcraft allows you to publish your application to Nordcraft's cloud infrastructure or export for self-hosting. Configure domains, SSL, and environment settings in just a few clicks.

The styling and layout system in Nordcraft helps you write CSS visually, presenting the most commonly used CSS properties in the style panel. For more precise control, you can write CSS directly in the editor.
Variables provide a way to store temporary data within components and pages. They enable interactive behavior and dynamic content by maintaining state during a user's session.

HTML Elements are the basic building blocks that make up the interface of your page or component in Nordcraft. They create the structure,content,and interactive parts of your application that users see and interact with.

Server-Side Rendering (SSR) allows pages to be pre-rendered on the server before being sent to the client. This improves performance, reduces loading time, and enhances SEO by providing search engines with fully rendered HTML.

Nordcraft is the fastest and most frictionless way to write CSS. Just select the element you want to style. The style panel has all the tools you would expect for creating colors, gradients and box-shadows, and plenty you wouldn't!

Contexts in Nordcraft provide a way to share data and functionality between components at different levels of your application hierarchy. Unlike attributes and events which work between directly connected parent and child components,contexts allow for communication between ancestor and descendant components at any level.

Nordcraft's Drag and Drop Editor allows you to create pages and layouts visually by simply dragging elements and components into place. This enables rapid prototyping and provides a highly intuitive design experience.

Reactive data flow ensures that your interface always reflects the latest data. Signals track changes to variables and automatically propagate updates to components and elements depending on that data.
Upload images,media and other files to your Nordcraft projects for use in your applications. Uploaded files are served from Nordcraft's Content Delivery Network (CDN).

The issues panel helps you identify and resolve problems within your Nordcraft project. Providing an overview of issues covering accessibility, HTML validity and tips and tricks to optimize your project, it helps you maintain code quality and improve project stability.
Nordcraft's keyframe animation editor gives you fine control of every detail. Create complex compound animations in seconds and bring your website to life.

Nordcraft is open source. The framework and runtime is licensed under Apache 2.0. You can self-host your applications on your own infrastructure,giving you complete control over deployment,performance,security,and data privacy.
Nordcraft has first class support for GraphQL. The query builder makes working with GraphQL APIs joyful and frictionless.

The Package system allows you to publish reusable components, templates, and functions. You can share these across multiple projects to maintain consistency across your projects and prevent you having to rebuild the same functionality over and over again.

Choose the right tool for the job. Nordcraft's visual scripting language is great for most scenarios, but for some problems you just can't beat code. Nordcraft comes with Monaco built in: the same editor that powers VS Code.
Organize global CSS variables into themes. Automatically detect light or dark mode or create delightful theme switchers.
Nordcraft lets you connect to any external data source through APIs. This allows your application to communicate with any external services,databases,and back ends.

In Nordcraft you get access to your very own AI assistant that understands the context of your projects and knows how to build for the web. The AI Assistant is also trained on the Nordcraft documentation,videos,blog posts,and forum discussions.

value.value: Built Out of Love for the Web
The Next Leap is Not Another Framework

We think it is unlikely that we will see a new framework that will push web development forward to the same degree as AngularJS and React did. Instead of looking for the next abstraction, we believe the next leap will be about
The component abstraction has completely changed the way we build web applications, and has been a big part of why the web has grown into the largest application platform in the world.
When AngularJS and React popularized the idea of components as a new abstraction for the web, it instantly became popular. But the next leap will likely look very different.
We want you to use Nordcraft because it’s the best option, not because you’re locked in and can't escape. Open sourcing the Nordcraft platform ensures we earn your choice every day.

LLMs will be part of this story. They are incredibly effective at generating large amounts of boilerplate code very quickly. But LLMs are blunt instruments: they are efficient but imprecise, good for rough tasks but clumsy when it comes to the details.
Open Source is More Important Than Ever

Open source breaks this cycle by giving developers real ownership. With open-source tools, you can host your own stack, modify the code, extend it, or even build commercial products on top of it. Your work isn’t tied to a company’s survival, pricing strategy, or roadmap.
Nordcraft, on the other hand, is a tool for
We built the tool we always wanted

Even platforms that offer code export rarely solve the problem. What you get back is often hard to read, hard to maintain, and never truly designed for long-term use. You end up stuck in the same loop: keep paying, rebuild, or walk away.

value.value: You never have to wait for deploys again. Each branch has its own live environment and URL you can share with your team. When you are ready to publish your changes, you go live in milliseconds.
The web is amazing. It is the greatest platform ever built for content, media and applications.

When you rely on these closed platforms, you give up control. Even if you “own” your app, you can’t run it without the provider. Sudden pricing hikes, new limitations, or a complete shutdown can force you into tough choices: pay more, rebuild from scratch, or shut down operations entirely. Your product becomes entirely dependent on someone else’s business decisions.

Ever since, framework authors have been looking for the next big thing: for the framework that can replace React. But what we have seen is a convergence where modern frameworks look more and more identical.
With HTML, CSS and JavaScript you can create beautiful, engaging and accessible experiences that come alive with animations and interactions.

So many of us are relying on closed platforms and services to publish things to the web: hosting, content management, databases, drag-and-drop website builders and more. What happens if one of those services goes away overnight?
In Nordcraft, every change you make happens in real time. There's no waiting for builds or hot reloading. You are limited only by how quickly you can work.
When you build on Nordcraft, you own your application. The Nordcraft runtime is available under the Apache 2.0 License, allowing you to self-host, modify, reuse, or even resell it however you want.

Nordcraft is built by web developers for web developers and made for those who believe the web deserves better than yet another JS framework.

We designed Nordcraft to embrace and enhance the best part of the web platform. In Nordcraft, you still have the full power of HTML, CSS and JavaScript but with a visual editor built specifically for working with each language.

videos.title: Building for The Web in Nordcraft
videos.description: Learn about what's covered in the Nordcraft Fundamentals course, who the course is for, and how to use it.

videos.description: Experience an in-depth tour of the Nordcraft editor to prepare you for the rest of the course.

videos.description: Understand how you can use the built-in AI assistant to automate the boring parts of web development, so you can focus on being creative.

value.title: HTML

videos.title: Adding HTML elements
videos.description: Learn about HTML, and how to add and organize HTML elements in Nordcraft to structure the content on your website.

videos.title: Using HTML element attributes
videos.description: Learn how to customize the behavior and interactivity of HTML elements using HTML attributes.

videos.title: HTML for accessibility
videos.description: Tips on choosing the right HTML elements and attributes to make sure your page is accessible to as many people as possible.

value.description: Learn about HTML and how it powers the structure of content on The Web.

value.title: CSS

videos.title: Get to know the Nordcraft style panel
videos.description: Experience an in-depth tour of the Nordcraft style panel to prepare you for the rest of the CSS module.

videos.title: Default user agent styles vs the CSS reset
videos.description: Understand that browsers apply CSS styling to HTML by default, and how Nordcraft removes some of it to give you more of a blank canvas to work with.

videos.title: Adding style variants
videos.description: Learn how to apply different styles for hover, focus, active and disabled states, and how to use media queries to modify styles for different screen sizes.

videos.title: Layouts: the box model
videos.description: Learn how padding, margin, border and content work together in CSS so you can build and debug page layouts with confidence.

videos.title: Layouts: the display property
videos.description: Understand the different types of display properties in CSS and how they influence layouts, including flex, block, inline and grid.

videos.title: Layouts: responsive design and fluid layouts
videos.description: Learn how to use flexbox to create responsive layouts without using CSS media queries, and learn about relative units in CSS.

videos.title: Layouts: positioning and stacking
videos.description: Learn about how different CSS position values create different stacking contexts to understand how HTML elements can be positioned and layered.

videos.title: Fluid typography
videos.description: Learn how to create responsive font sizes without using CSS media queries.

videos.title: The Nordcraft color picker
videos.description: Understand how to use the Nordcraft color picker to find your perfect colors.

videos.title: Creating beautiful gradients
videos.description: Learn how to create different types of color gradients using the Nordcraft color picker.

videos.title: Using CSS variables and themes
videos.description: Understand how to create reusable CSS variables to manage themes.

videos.title: Advanced CSS properties
videos.description: Learn how to add and edit advanced CSS properties that aren't yet supported natively in the Nordcraft style panel.

value.description: Learn about modern CSS and its powerful cabilities in styling content on The Web.

value.title: CSS animations

videos.title: Get to know the Nordcraft animation editor
videos.description: Experience an in-depth tour of the Nordcraft animation editor so you can start building beautiful CSS animations visually.

videos.title: Combining animations
videos.description: Learn how to combine animations using the Nordcraft animation editor.

value.description: Learn how to create beautiful animations and interactions using the power of modern CSS and a visual animation editor.

value.title: Events

videos.title: Making your website interactive
videos.description: Learn about default interactive behavior of HTML elements, and get a tour of the Nordcraft events panel.

videos.title: Adding events to HTML elements
videos.description: Understand how to add events to HTML elements using the Nordcraft events panel.

value.description: Learn about HTML interactivity and how to make your websites interactive using events.

value.title: Formulas

videos.title: Get to know the Nordcraft formula editor
videos.description: Experience an in-depth tour of the Nordcraft formula editor to prepare you for the rest of the module.

videos.title: Using variables to manage state
videos.description: Learn how to create and update variables using the Nordcraft formula editor.

videos.title: The show/hide formula
videos.description: Understand how to show or hide elements based on specific conditions.

videos.title: The repeat formula
videos.description: Learn how to use the repeat formula to create multiple instances of an element based on a set of data.

videos.title: Building reusable formulas
videos.description: Learn how to create self-contained reusable formulas that you can use in the formula editor.

videos.title: Dynamic CSS using formulas
videos.description: Learn how to use the formula editor to create CSS variables and conditional CSS classes based on data and different conditions.

videos.title: Creating custom actions using JavaScript
videos.description: Understand how to use JavaScript code to build custom actions in the editor, and when you might need to do so.

value.description: Learn how to transform data, perform calculations, and create conditional logic in your projects using the formula editor.

videos.title: Connect to any API
videos.description: Learn how to connect your project to any back-end data source using the Nordcraft API panel.

videos.title: Getting data from a REST API
videos.description: Learn how to fetch and configure data from REST APIs in Nordcraft, including setting query parameters, HTTP headers, and using the API response panel.

videos.title: Getting data from a GraphQL API
videos.description: Learn how to fetch and configure data from GraphQL APIs in Nordcraft, including building GraphQL queries, setting GraphQL variables, and using the API response panel.

videos.title: Use API data anywhere in the Nordcraft editor
videos.description: Learn how you can use data from APIs anywhere in your project, and how you can use the formula editor to organize and manipulate that data.

value.description: Learn how to connect to any back-end API to fetch data for your website.

value.value: The dnd-list is the primary component of the Spark Drag and Drop Package, providing a wrapper around SortableJS for integration into Toddle. By default, any element placed inside the default slot - be it a div, an li element, or a custom component - becomes sortable through drag and drop. It works immediately without any attribute modifications, yet it allows for extensive customization to suit various use cases, implementing nearly all options from SortableJS.
This page gives a detailed overview of the package’s components. There are three different components: dnd-list, dnd-item and dnd-handle.

value.value: The dnd-item component functions as a helper within the drag-and-drop ecosystem, seamlessly integrating with the dnd-list. Essentially, the dnd-item serves as a wrapper for your actual list items, conveying two key pieces of information to its children: whether the current item is being dragged (isChosen) and whether it serves as a placeholder for the drop target (isGhost).
